$comment: schema_version 1.0.0; tracks the private design/spec/ledger-checkpoint-v1.md and ADR-0094 (A). In-capsule record at capsule_dir/.ledger/checkpoint.json. Additive/optional alongside the byte-identical jsonl evidence streams; the per-stream sidecar chains live in capsule_dir/.ledger/<stream>.chain.json. DSSE-signed by the ADR-0089 RatchetSigner, appended to the ADR-0041 MerkleLog, and externally anchored (ADR-0070 RFC3161 / ADR-0071 Sigstore).
title: LedgerCheckpoint
description: A multi-stream checkpoint of an Adversary-Anchored Accountability Ledger (ADR-0094). Aggregates the sealed head of every per-stream sidecar chain in a capsule plus the binding identity (node epoch + agent + principal), so a verifier can prove no stream was truncated, reordered, or rewritten below the signed head.

schema_version.description: OAS v1.0 schema version. Must be 1.x.x (ADR-0034 §1).

checkpoint_id.description: Unique identifier for this checkpoint within the capsule.

capsule_id.description: run_id of the capsule whose streams this checkpoint seals.

created_at.description: When the checkpoint record was assembled (RFC 3339, UTC).

kind.description: Checkpoint cadence. 'finalize' = once at run end (local-mode default, one anchor call/run). 'batch' = amortized batch-root sealed at the hub (cluster mode, keeps crypto off the compute hot path). 'interim' = optional in-run checkpoint.

prev_checkpoint_id.description: checkpoint_id of the previous checkpoint for this capsule, or null for the first. Lets verifiers chain multiple interim checkpoints.

streams.description: One sealed head per evidence stream covered by this checkpoint. The set of streams is recorded so a verifier can detect a stream dropped entirely (omission) versus truncated (seq_high < observed).

identity.description: The node/agent/principal binding sealed by this checkpoint — the principal -> agent -> action delegation chain (ADR-0094 §identity-to-action binding).

merkle.description: Reference to this checkpoint's entry in the NovaSeal MerkleLog (ADR-0041). Populated after the checkpoint is appended to the log.

anchor.description: External anchor binding (RFC 3161 timestamp and/or Sigstore/Rekor transparency entry). Absent until the checkpoint is anchored.

signature.description: DSSE signature over the canonical checkpoint body produced by the ADR-0089 RatchetSigner. The body excludes the signature, merkle, and anchor blocks (all populated post-signing).

extensions.description: Vendor extensions. Keys must be reverse-DNS-prefixed.

stream.description: Logical stream name, matching the sidecar chain file capsule_dir/.ledger/<stream>.chain.json, e.g. 'model-calls', 'tool-calls', 'network_events', 'file_events', 'audit'.

chain_file.description: Relative path within the capsule to the sidecar chain file, e.g. '.ledger/model-calls.chain.json'.

jsonl_file.description: Relative path within the capsule to the byte-identical evidence stream the chain covers, e.g. 'model-calls.jsonl'. The chain is a sidecar; the jsonl is never modified.

seq_high.description: Highest sequence number sealed for this stream at checkpoint time (0-based; -1 means an empty stream). Truncation below this value after signing is detectable.

record_count.description: Number of records sealed for this stream (seq_high + 1 for a gap-free chain). Recorded so a verifier can detect a seq gap independently of seq_high.

head_link_hash.description: link_hash of the head (highest-seq) entry of the sidecar chain. A single value that the whole content chain cascades into; any content edit, reorder, or gap changes it.

StreamHead.description: Sealed head of one per-stream sidecar chain. Each chain entry is {seq, prev_hash, link_hash} where link_hash = sha256(seq || prev_hash || sha256(record_bytes)).

node_id.description: Node identity sealing the checkpoint (ADR-0089 ratchet node).

epoch.description: Ratchet epoch of the signing key (ADR-0089). Monotonic per node; a checkpoint claiming an epoch below an already-observed epoch is an epoch rollback.

epoch_pubkey.description: Ed25519 public key of the epoch-i signing key. Verifiers resolve and trust the registry-published value, not this carried copy (ADR-0089 §3).

agent_id.description: Agent identity bound to the sealed actions (event-envelope agent_id). Binds the agent leg of principal -> agent -> action.

principal.description: OIDC/RBAC subject the run executed under (the PolicySubject replay/_engine.py already uses). The root of the delegation chain.

IdentityBinding.description: Binds node (epoch key) + agent (record field) + actions (stream heads) under one ratchet signature.

root.description: Merkle root the checkpoint leaf was included under.

leaf_hash.description: Leaf hash of this checkpoint in the MerkleLog.

log_index.description: Position of the leaf in the append-only MerkleLog.

inclusion_proof.description: Audit path (sibling hashes) proving leaf_hash is included under root, RFC 6962-style.

MerkleRef.description: Inclusion of this checkpoint in the NovaSeal MerkleLog (ADR-0041).

method.description: External anchor mechanism. 'rfc3161' = RFC 3161 timestamp token (ADR-0070). 'sigstore-rekor' = Sigstore transparency entry (ADR-0071). 'none' = not externally anchored (offline, anchor deferred).

anchored_value.description: The value anchored externally — the Merkle root (cluster batch) or the checkpoint signature digest (local finalize). The verifier recomputes it and compares against the external proof.

rfc3161_token_ref.description: Relative path to the embedded RFC 3161 timestamp token (.tsr), when method is 'rfc3161'.

rekor_log_index.description: Rekor log index, when method is 'sigstore-rekor'.

rekor_log_id.description: Rekor instance log id, when method is 'sigstore-rekor'.

anchored_at.description: When the external anchor was obtained (RFC 3339).

ExternalAnchor.description: External anchor that places the checkpoint beyond the reach of a host/key-compromised operator. A mismatch between anchored_value and the recomputed root/signature is anchor tampering.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm of the ratchet epoch key (ADR-0089 Ed25519).

value.description: Base64-encoded DSSE signature over the canonical checkpoint body.

Signature.description: DSSE signature produced by the ADR-0089 RatchetSigner at the recorded epoch.
